cases.text: To keep a clear record, Leah Cole measured a change of −12 °C on 2 May 2025 and +3 °C on 3 May 2025. The reported range was 12–15 °C. These readings do not prove that the device caused the change.

claims.description: Range is distinct from unary minus
The readings do not establish device causation
